title: The Justice Department gives Trump an unprecedented settlement
script: Here is what viewers need to know right now. The key update now being reported is: The Justice Department gives Trump an unprecedented settlement. In simple words, D.O.J. gave Trump and his family immunity from tax audits and set up a $1.8 billion fund for victims of "government weaponization." Former government lawyer Andrew Weissmann explains the settlement Some details may change as more information becomes available, so viewers should check trusted news sources for the newest update. We will continue watching for clearer and more reliable updates.
